summary: Game crashes when player model is rendered after the player is stung by a bee
description: The bug When getting stung by a bee, the game crashes as soon as the player model is rendered. To reproduce There are multiple ways to reproduce this issue: Inventory - Get stung by a bee - Open your inventory Third-person camera - Enable third-person camera - Get stung by a bee Crash report 19w39a : [^crash-2019-09-27_13.19.08-client.txt] Description: Rendering entity in world java.lang.IllegalStateException: Not filled all elements of the vertex at cxk.a(SourceFile:253) at dwx.a(SourceFile:56) at dyd.a(SourceFile:48) at dyd.a(SourceFile:14) at duw.a(SourceFile:138) at dym.a(SourceFile:64) at dym.a(SourceFile:41) at dtz.a(SourceFile:268) at dtz.a(SourceFile:253) at dgt.a(SourceFile:134) at dgt.a(SourceFile:106) at dfx.render(SourceFile:82) at dgm.render(SourceFile:42) at dgt.render(SourceFile:86) at dpo.a(SourceFile:603) at dat.d(SourceFile:931) at dat.b(SourceFile:569) at net.minecraft.client.main.Main.main(SourceFile:199)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft.
2. Create a new Creative world with default settings.
3. Enable the third-person camera.
4. Get stung by a bee.
5. Wait for the player model to render.
6. Observe that the game crashes with an error related to rendering the player model.
Observed Behavior: The game experiences a critical crash when the player model is rendered immediately after the player is stung by a bee. This issue can be reproduced in two main scenarios: first, by getting stung by a bee and then opening the inventory, and second, by enabling the third-person camera, getting stung by a bee, and then rendering the player model. The crash report generated during this event indicates a java.lang.IllegalStateException with a message stating that not all elements of the vertex are filled, which occurs within the rendering process of entities in the game world. The specific error trace points to various methods in the rendering pipeline, ultimately leading to the main method in the Minecraft client. This bug appears to disrupt the normal rendering flow, causing the game to terminate unexpectedly when the player model is supposed to be displayed.
Expected Behavior: When a player is stung by a bee, the game should continue to run smoothly without crashing, allowing the player to view their character model in both first-person and third-person perspectives. The rendering of the player model should occur seamlessly, enabling players to interact with their inventory or navigate the world without any interruption or errors. This expected behavior should be consistent across all game versions where the bee mechanics are implemented.
